newsitem.title: USA: Optiva and Teledyne Water Pik settle suits.
newsitem.headline: Optiva and Teledyne Water Pik settle suits.

text.p: Optiva Corp and Teledyne Water Pik, a division of Teledyne Industries Inc, said on Monday that they had settled all law suits pending between them.

In the settlement, Teledyne Water Pik agrees to pay an undisclosed amount to Optiva, and Teledyne Water Pik agrees to acquire from Optiva a non-exclusive license of Optiva's patent, the two companies said a statement.
The license calls for Teledyne Water Pik to pay Optiva royalties based on future net sales of Teledyne Water Pik's SenSonic product, the companies said.
The suits included patent, trade secrets and unfair competition claims and counterclaims.
